snippet.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 - Developer Overview Trailer | gamescom 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Developer Overview Trailer for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, the latest addition to the first-person shooter franchise. Hear from the developers about the journey players will take in the co-op campaign to explore the perception of reality as a whole and get a look at new gameplay mechanics. Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 is launching on November 14th for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
